data.name: Spark Soul
data.description: The shaman gains electricity resistance 10. In addition, as a standard action she can unleash a 20-foot line of sparks from her fingertips, dealing %1d4 points of electricity damage. A successful Reflex saving throw (DC %2) halves this damage. The shaman can use this ability three times per day, but she must wait 1d4 rounds between each use.|ShamanSparkSoulDice|ShamanSparkSoulDC
